title: Granite Ridge Season Pass Tariff: Terms for Moving Up a Tier
content:
Four figures are published for each tier of the Granite Ridge Season Pass Programme where the holder moves up to a higher tier during the season: whether a move up is offered from that tier, the basis on which the amount due is worked out, the service fee placed on the pass account, and the last calendar date on which the move up may be recorded.

| Tier moved up from | Move up offered | Differential basis | Service fee (USD) | Last date a move up may be recorded |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Granite Ridge Four-Day Flex Pass | yes | price paid basis | 35.00 | 28 February |
| Granite Ridge Midweek Pass | yes | price paid basis | 35.00 | 28 February |
| Granite Ridge Local Pass | yes | price paid basis | 35.00 | 28 February |
| Granite Ridge Summit Pass | yes | list price basis | 45.00 | 28 February |
| Granite Ridge Summit Plus Pass | yes | list price basis | 45.00 | 15 March |
| Granite Ridge Collective Unlimited Pass | yes | list price basis | 45.00 | 15 March |
| Granite Ridge Collective Elite Pass | no | list price basis | 45.00 | 15 March |

The Granite Ridge Collective Elite Pass is the only tier of the programme from which a move up is not offered; its basis, fee and date are published in the tariff all the same.

The two bases are named for the figure the higher tier is taken at. On the price paid basis the higher tier is taken at the price the guest would be charged today; on the list price basis it is taken at the higher tier's standard season price.
